reason: Wendy's is a franchisor and operator of quick-service hamburger restaurants. It sells prepared food to consumers and earns royalties and franchise fees. Coca-Cola Consolidated is a bottler and distributor of beverages. It sells wholesale to retailers and foodservice accounts. The products differ, the customers differ (B2C diners versus B2B retail and foodservice), and the revenue models differ. Restaurants are only one of many outlets the bottler serves.
